query - container apps inventory.query:
Resources
| where resourceGroup =~ '{ResourceGroup}'
| where type =~ 'microsoft.app/containerapps'
| project name, location, runningStatus = tostring(properties.runningStatus), latestRevisionName = tostring(properties.latestRevisionName)

query - container apps replicas.query:
AzureMetrics
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where ResourceGroup =~ '{ResourceGroup}'
| where ResourceProvider == "MICROSOFT.APP"
| where MetricName == "Replicas"
| summarize CurrentValue = toreal(max(Maximum)) by Resource
| project Resource, CurrentReplicas = CurrentValue
| sort by Resource asc

query - container apps cpu and memory.query:
AzureMetrics
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where ResourceGroup =~ '{ResourceGroup}'
| where ResourceProvider == "MICROSOFT.APP"
| where MetricName in ("CpuPercentage", "MemoryPercentage")
| summarize AvgPercent = avg(Average), MaxPercent = max(Maximum), P95Percent = percentile(Maximum, 95) by Resource, MetricName
| project Resource, Metric = MetricName, AvgPercent = round(AvgPercent, 1), MaxPercent = round(MaxPercent, 1), P95Percent = round(P95Percent, 1)
| sort by Resource asc

query - container apps environment statu.query:
Resources
| where resourceGroup =~ '{ResourceGroup}'
| where type =~ 'microsoft.app/managedenvironments'
| project name, location, provisioningState = tostring(properties.provisioningState)

query - cosmos db inventory.query:
Resources
| where resourceGroup =~ '{ResourceGroup}'
| where type =~ 'microsoft.documentdb/databaseaccounts'
| project name, location, provisioningState = tostring(properties.provisioningState), throughputLimit = tostring(properties.capacity.totalThroughputLimit)

query - cosmos db consumed ru.query:
AzureMetrics
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where ResourceGroup =~ '{ResourceGroup}'
| where ResourceProvider == "MICROSOFT.DOCUMENTDB"
| where MetricName == "TotalRequestUnits" or MetricName == "ProvisionedThroughput"
| summarize AvgConsumed = avg(iff(MetricName == "TotalRequestUnits", Total, real(0))), PeakConsumed = max(iff(MetricName == "TotalRequestUnits", Total, real(0))), AvgProvisioned = avg(iff(MetricName == "ProvisionedThroughput", Average, real(0))) by Resource
| project Resource, AvgConsumedRU = round(AvgConsumed, 1), PeakConsumedRU = round(PeakConsumed, 1), ProvisionedRU = round(AvgProvisioned, 1)

query - cosmos db latency.query:
AzureMetrics
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where ResourceGroup =~ '{ResourceGroup}'
| where ResourceProvider == "MICROSOFT.DOCUMENTDB"
| where MetricName == "ServerSideLatency"
| summarize AvgLatency = avg(Average), P95Latency = percentile(Maximum, 95), MaxLatency = max(Maximum) by Resource
| project Resource, AvgLatency = round(AvgLatency, 2), P95Latency = round(P95Latency, 2), MaxLatency = round(MaxLatency, 2)

query - cosmos db ru utilization.query:
AzureMetrics
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where ResourceGroup =~ '{ResourceGroup}'
| where ResourceProvider == "MICROSOFT.DOCUMENTDB"
| where MetricName == "NormalizedRUConsumption"
| summarize AvgNormalizedRUConsumption = avg(Average), MaxNormalizedRUConsumption = max(Maximum), P95NormalizedRUConsumption = percentile(Maximum, 95) by Resource
| project Resource, AvgNormalizedRUConsumption = round(AvgNormalizedRUConsumption, 2), MaxNormalizedRUConsumption = round(MaxNormalizedRUConsumption, 2), P95NormalizedRUConsumption = round(P95NormalizedRUConsumption, 2)

query - cosmos db storage.query:
AzureMetrics
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where ResourceGroup =~ '{ResourceGroup}'
| where ResourceProvider == "MICROSOFT.DOCUMENTDB"
| where MetricName in ("DataUsage", "DocumentQuota")
| summarize CurrentGB = max(Maximum) / 1024 / 1024 / 1024 by Resource, MetricName
| project Resource, Metric = MetricName, CurrentGB = round(CurrentGB, 3)
